effect:
Prevents stat reduction by opponents. (Hold)

Clear Amulet protects your Pokémon from having its stats lowered by enemy moves or abilities. Intimidate and moves like Charm won't work on ya!

This is solid on physical attackers that hurt from Intimidate or Pokémon that run setup moves and don't want to be debuffed. It doesn't prevent self-inflicted stat drops like from Close Combat, though. A nice defensive option against certain compositions!
